scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync:place-pipeline && npm run prepare:vosk-model && npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:release: npm run sync:place-pipeline && npm run prepare:vosk-model && NEXT_PUBLIC_DEBUG_PANEL=false NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://atlas-junior.vercel.app npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.aab:release:
node scripts/bump-version.js && npm run cap:sync:release && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease && cp ../android/app/src/main/play/release-notes/en-US/default.txt ../android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/release-notes.txt && echo "
✅ Release build ready:
   AAB:   android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab
   Notes: android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/release-notes.txt"
scripts.apk:release:
npm run cap:sync:release && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && echo "
✅ APK ready: android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
📝 Release notes: android/app/src/main/play/release-notes/en-US/default.txt
📋 Changelog:    CHANGELOG.md"
scripts.build:web: npm run sync:place-pipeline && NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/game NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://atlas-junior.vercel.app next build
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:web && rm -rf backend/public/game && mkdir -p backend/public/game && cp -r out/* backend/public/game/
